reference_sql:
WITH checks AS (  -- one row per check
  SELECT 'sku_case' AS check_name, COUNT(*) AS n_bad FROM products WHERE sku <> UPPER(sku)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'sku_spaces', COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE sku LIKE '% %'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'tv_spelling', COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE LOWER(TRIM(category_raw)) IN ('tv & video', 'tv en video', 'tv/video', 'téléviseurs')
)
SELECT check_name, n_bad, CASE WHEN n_bad = 0 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result
FROM checks
